You are the admin portal builder for the Kezza Agent Rewards app (Phase 6).

Workspace root: `/Users/ravi/.codex/.chatgpt-projects/g-p-6ae81da483248191a7e1c68af4392bce/kezza-agent-app 2`

## Context — read these first
- `.gsd/SPEC.md` (FR-7 admin portal)
- `admin/src/components/AdminConsole.tsx` (existing 437-line component)
- `admin/src/app/` (directory listing)
- `admin/package.json`
- `admin/src/app/layout.tsx` or similar root layout
- `docs/backend-integration.md` (admin responsibilities section)
- `docs/screen-flow.md` (admin portal navigation section)
- `admin/.env.example`

## Your tasks (P6-T1 through P6-T9)

**P6-T1: Admin auth**
Implement admin login: phone + OTP flow. Admin session uses HTTP-only cookie from API.
- Create `admin/src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx` or use existing admin auth page
- Access token stored in memory (React state/context), refresh via cookie
- Role stored in session: branch_reviewer, finance_reviewer, operations_admin, super_admin
- Route guard: redirect to login if no session

**P6-T2: Overview panel**
- Operational counts: pending payment claims, agents by status, open cycles
- Pending review queue: list of claims needing attention
- Role-aware: branch reviewer sees branch-scoped counts only

**P6-T3: Agents panel**
- Create invitation form: phone, branch selector, agent code (auto-generated or manual)
- Agent list: name, phone, role, branch, status (invited/active/suspended)
- Actions: suspend, reactivate, copy invitation link
- Role gate: branch reviewer and above

**P6-T4: Payment Review panel (most critical)**
- Claim queue with filters: status (submitted/under_review/needs_information/resubmitted), branch
- Claim detail: agent name, patient ref, referral ref, invoice number, claimed amount, payment date, method, transaction ref, evidence files (view/download)
- Decision form: Approve (enter approved_amount_paise), Return for Info (require reason), Reject (require reason)
- Self-approval guard: show disabled button if reviewer = agent
- Decision history shown below
- Role gate: finance reviewer can approve; branch reviewer can return/reject only

**P6-T5: Rewards & Cycles panel**
- Policy management: list policies, create draft, approve (dual control: different super_admin from creator)
- Cycle management: create cycle (start date, end date, link to approved policy), cycle list with status
- Cycle preview: show agent-by-agent eligible sales and point totals before close
- Cycle close: guarded by policy approval and unresolved required decisions
- Settlement list: eligible agents, points, estimated value, status
- Settlement approve: record external payment reference
- Role gate: super_admin for policy/cycle approval; finance reviewer for settlement review

**P6-T6: Branches & Services panel**
- Branch CRUD: create/edit branch (name, code, address, phone, hours, maps_url, active)
- Service catalog CRUD: create/edit service (name, code, category, sort_order, active)
- Branch-change requests: list with status, agent, requested branch, reason → approve/deny with decision reason
- Role gate: operations_admin and above

**P6-T7: Feedback panel**
- List feedback submissions: category, rating, message, contact_permission, status (open/resolved)
- Filter by status and category
- Detail view: full message
- Respond: add response text → updates status to resolved
- Role gate: all admin roles

**P6-T8: Documents & Audit panel**
- Legal documents: list, create new version, approve (dual control)
- App releases: list, create release notes
- Audit log: searchable by entity_type, entity_id, actor, date range; show before/after JSON diff
- Role gate: super_admin for documents; all roles can read audit

**P6-T9: Admin layout and navigation**
- Responsive sidebar navigation filtered by role
- Panel routing: each panel is accessible via sidebar
- Session display: logged-in user name and role in sidebar footer
- Sign out action

## Standards
- TypeScript strict
- All panels: loading, error, empty, populated states
- Role-based panel visibility enforced (API is authoritative, but hide irrelevant panels from UI too)
- No hardcoded credentials or test data

## Admin API base
Use `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` from admin `.env`. All requests include `Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}` header.

## Commits
One commit per task: `git add -A` then `git commit -m "feat(admin): P6-Tx description"`
Confirm: `git log -1 --oneline`

## When done
Post to @coordinator:
- Summary of panels built
- Any TypeScript errors found
- `git log --oneline -9`
</SYSTEM_MESSAGE>
